transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Could each of you let me know if there are any relevant issues on your end that I should be aware of before I sign off on this escrow release?

transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag a tax issue before you approve this release. I confirmed in a tax memo received today that the seller is a nonresident entity, which means the escrow release is subject to 10% withholding on the gross amount paid. For a $5,000,000 gross release, that requires exactly $500,000 to be remitted to the tax authority within two business days. The memo has not yet been circulated to the closing team, so I'm raising it now to make sure the withholding is properly handled before you sign off.

This instruction has not yet been entered in the payment workflow, so it needs to be set up before you sign off to ensure proper accounting treatment.

Under the agreement, exactly $900,000 must remain in escrow until this indemnity claim is resolved. This means the full $5,000,000 cannot be released — at most $4,100,000 could be released, with $900,000 retained pending resolution of the claim.
